effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] By placing 1 card from your hand face down under any of your [Keenan Crier]s, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand.
